The '''Hassaria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hassarian/Legends|Hassarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TT" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hassaria system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square I-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
